summary: Fresh independent canonical audit pinned to the curated Jiuwudaishi 087 source and extraction. Read all 90 Chinese units and checked all 160 temporal/hint items and 41 people. The curation correctly preserves fifteen nonpersonal or discontiguous-date research holds, but nineteen repairable items remain: a continuous interval for noncontiguous eras, a strict lower bound, three borrowed personal dates, and active-life hints contaminated by posthumous reception or full-reign expansion. This version therefore remains needs-revision.
